text_block_list.text:
I happen across Эйсин Флэш, but she
looks upset
for some reason.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I was looking for a particular ingredient
so I could
make a dish I often ate back
home, but...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Did they not have it in stock?

text_block_list.text:
Caviar is very expensive in Japan... It is
far
beyond what I could afford on my
budget.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
She's not wrong about the price, and I

unfortunately can't offer to buy it for
her. Eishin
Flash trudges away
desolately.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
